translationRepairs: That year sectarian rebels erupted in Huaxian and spread into Shandong; he impeached Heze instructor Song Xuan, a military licentiate who had joined the rebels and escaped detection; sought honors for Kong Yujun and licentiate Kong Yuzhong of Caozhou, who died fighting the rebels; and rewarded Jinxiang licentiate Li Jiubiao for capturing a rebel leader.

That year sectarian rebels erupted in Huaxian and spread into Shandong; he impeached and dismissed Song Xuan, the Heze instructor, for failing to detect military licentiates practicing the sect; sought honors for Kong Yujun and licentiate Kong Yuzhong of Caozhou, who died fighting the rebels; and rewarded Jinxiang licentiate Li Jiubiao for capturing a rebel leader.

s0120 has 劾罷失察武生習教之菏澤訓導宋璇: Song Xuan is the Heze instructor impeached and dismissed for failure to detect military licentiates practicing the sect, not himself a rebel. The prior idiomatic invents that he joined the rebels; the proposed wording restores the Chinese sense.
In the 32nd year, he was assigned to the Maojin Hall, where he joined others in copying sutras to pray for blessings for the Empress Dowager.
In the 32nd year, he was assigned to the Maoqin Hall, where he joined others in copying sutras to pray for blessings for the Empress Dowager.
s0007 has 直懋勤殿; 懋勤 is Maoqin (Hall of Assiduous Diligence), not Maojin. The literal misromanization is a real error; Maoqin Hall matches the Chinese and the idiomatic sense.
